checks.name: conversation_answers_body_check
checks.definition: CHECK (((passed AND (body = ''::text)) OR ((NOT passed) AND ((char_length(body) >= 1) AND (char_length(body) <= 2400)))))

checks.name: profiles_alias_completo_format
checks.definition: CHECK (((eliminado_en IS NOT NULL) OR (estado_identidad = 'huevo'::text) OR (((char_length(alias_completo) >= 8) AND (char_length(alias_completo) <= 64)) AND (alias_completo ~ '^[a-záéíóúüñ]+( [a-záéíóúüñ]+)* · [BCDFGHJKLMNPQRSTVWXYZ]{4}$'::text) AND (alias_completo = ((((alias_animal || ' '::text) || alias_color) || ' · '::text) || alias_sufijo)) AND (alias_sufijo ~ '^[BCDFGHJKLMNPQRSTVWXYZ]{4}$'::text) AND (alias_animal ~ '^[a-záéíóúüñ]+( [a-záéíóúüñ]+)*$'::text) AND (alias_color ~ '^[a-záéíóúüñ]+( [a-záéíóúüñ]+)*$'::text))))

checks.name: profiles_identity_shape
checks.definition:
CHECK (((eliminado_en IS NOT NULL) OR
CASE estado_identidad
    WHEN 'huevo'::text THEN ((animal_id IS NULL) AND (color_id IS NULL) AND (alias_completo IS NULL) AND (alias_animal IS NULL) AND (alias_color IS NULL) AND (alias_sufijo IS NULL) AND (enneagram_code IS NULL) AND (eclosionado_en IS NULL))
    ELSE ((animal_id IS NOT NULL) AND (color_id IS NOT NULL) AND (alias_completo IS NOT NULL) AND (alias_animal IS NOT NULL) AND (alias_color IS NOT NULL) AND (alias_sufijo IS NOT NULL) AND (eclosionado_en IS NOT NULL))
END))

checks.name: quiz_responses_one_kind
checks.definition: CHECK ((((likert_value IS NOT NULL) AND (selected_options IS NULL)) OR ((likert_value IS NULL) AND (selected_options IS NOT NULL))))
